journeyGroups.why: Why now: HR onboarding has observed required-field validation at both Personal and Job details, plus a successful client-side advance that does not create an employee. Observations: #18 and #19 (hannah.blake).

scenarios.name: Validate required personal information before continuing onboarding
scenarios.gherkin:
Given hannah.blake is on the new-hire Personal information step
When she continues with the required personal information fields blank
Then the Personal information step remains displayed
And messages state that first name, last name, and a valid email address are required

scenarios.name: Advance from valid personal information to job details without creating an employee
scenarios.gherkin:
Given hannah.blake is on the new-hire Personal information step
When she enters valid values for the required personal information and continues
Then the Job details step is displayed
And no new employee is created

scenarios.name: Validate required job details before continuing onboarding
scenarios.gherkin:
Given hannah.blake is on the new-hire Job details step
When she continues with Department, Job title, and Start date blank
Then the Job details step remains displayed
And messages state that Department, Job title, and Start date are required

journeyGroups.why: Why now: applying Engineering is observed to narrow Emily's directory from 28 to 8 Engineering employees and collapse pagination to one page. Observations: #5 and #6 (Emily.dawson).

scenarios.name: Filter the employee directory to Engineering
scenarios.gherkin:
Given Emily.dawson is viewing the employee directory
When she selects Engineering in the department filter
Then 8 Engineering employees are displayed
And pagination shows Page 1 of 1 with Previous and Next disabled
